map.电动工具细分对比计算器针对电钻、角磨等品类输入参数，量化对比性能与适用场景，辅助: The power tool segmented comparison calculator takes parameters for categories such as drills and angle grinders, quantifies and compares performance and applicable scenarios, and assists purchasing and R&D positioning.
map.对比电动扳手/电钻的扭矩、转速、功率选型。: Compare torque, speed and power when selecting among electric wrenches and drills.
map.按螺栓规格匹配扭矩。: Match torque to the bolt specification.
map.：电动扳手 A 最大扭矩 300N·m、B 200N·m：A 比 B 高 50%: : electric wrench A has a maximum torque of 300N·m against B's 200N·m: A is 50% higher and can turn M20 and above; B suits M12–M16 assembly.
map.：额定 18V、功耗 200W：电流 I = 200÷18 ≈ 11.1A，电池: : rated 18V, 200W: current I = 200÷18 ≈ 11.1A, so a 4Ah battery gives a theoretical runtime of ≈ 4÷11.1 ≈ 0.36h (continuous full load).
map.拉削（拉刀/齿升/拉力）设计: Broach (hob / tooth rise / cutting force) design
map.按螺栓等级与直径查扭矩表，如 M16 8.8 级约 100–160N·m；过大易: Look up torque from the bolt grade and diameter, e.g. M16 grade 8.8 is about 100–160N·m; too high snaps bolts or strips threads, too low loosens them.
map.无刷效率高、寿命长、发热小但贵；有刷便宜易维护，重载选无刷更耐用。: Brushless is more efficient, longer-lived and cooler but costs more; brushed is cheap and easy to maintain. Brushless is more durable for heavy loads.
